newsitem.title: USA: Candlewood sees 19-21 hotels opened by year end.
newsitem.headline: Candlewood sees 19-21 hotels opened by year end.

text.p: Candlewood Hotel Co Inc said Monday it is on track to have total of 19-21 company-owned hotels opened by the end of the year.

The hotel operator said it now has five company-owned and one franchised hotel open. The company also has 22 company-owned and four franchised hotels under construction, and is performing diligence with respect to 31 potential development sites which are under contract in a total of 24 states, the company said.

The company also exceeded its internal development goals for the quarter, placing seven company-owned hotels under construction during the three-month period, compared with a schedule that called for six construction starts, Candlewood said.
Earlier Monday, the company reported a net loss of $200,000, or $0.02 a share, for the second quarter, compared with a loss of $500,000, or $0.09 a share, a year ago.
